1. Convert 15 liters to gallons: liter_to_gallon(liter=15).
2. fillFuelTank(fuelAmount=converted gallons rounded to 2 decimals).
3. check_tire_pressure().
4. post_tweet(content=...).
5. startEngine(ignitionMode="START").
6. displayCarStatus(option="battery").
7. displayCarStatus(option="fuel").

We need to output the results. We'll call functions in order.
